stackDivergence.rationale: Task169 removes incorrect shared SfxBroadcaster/SfxListener inheritance from Writer clients: SwModify now derives from SwClient and owns the original WriterListener left/right relationships. Add preserves native anchor-right insertion; Remove repairs every active cursor current/position relation before clearing links/registration. Native WriterListenerIterator and exact SwIterator use actual JS constructor identity; JS iteration/finally binds loop scope, while a per-owner Set replaces the native global intrusive iterator ring and root filter without a refcount/lifetime library. No removed ForAllListeners/HasListeners/Notify/BroadcasterDying aliases remain on Writer owners; actual consumers use Writer iteration/registration/hook APIs. Native death/format-death callback order and reparenting are preserved. Existing browser optional callback,transaction batching and idempotent explicit disposal remain bounded local adaptations; batches are unpacked before the original native virtual hint filter and unrelated browser hints do not gain native propagation. No new shared notifier,allocator,weak manager or native compiler/probe. Actual shared Sfx notification correction remains a subsequent Calc pool prerequisite. Full WriterMultiListener/ListenerEntry/UnwrapMulti,native debug/global lifetime and full Writer/Calc document/UI/ODS parity remain unverified.
